gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noticia-text: Dignified is the first word that comes to mind for Noticia Text, a serif with generous curved entrances. Quantum, drawn in one unwavering line width, sits above it and keeps its letters loose and spacious, so the two feel clearly different.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-piazzolla: Refined and authoritative, Piazzolla carries a serif body whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with a pried-open e. And Quantum above it bends one uniform line into clean, loosely spaced shapes, like cable twisted into letters.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-scope-one: Traditional in manner, Scope One spills its counters into open space, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Quantum is best at crisp, unvarying lines up top; the body font is best at settling in.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-slabo-13px: Wire-thin and techy, Quantum leads with a monoline skeleton and loose spacing. And Slabo 13px, a bookish serif with large open counters in tall a, e and s, gives that wire a dignified partner.
gen-dafont-quantum-mulish: Quantum's loose, breezy spacing gives it away at once. Mulish follows in a sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation, horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height, so a long passage should flow smoothly and feel friendly.
gen-dafont-quantum-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab brings a structured, slab-serif body to the page. Under Quantum's plain stripe of constant ink, a long passage should read with a dense, precise texture, its open throats keeping the middle zone clear.
gen-dafont-quantum-rubik: Rubik's lowercase looks big beside its capitals, and its round letters stay open and soft. Quantum is best at spacious, hairline-free display lines; Rubik is best at staying legible small.
gen-dafont-redux-bitter: Bitter reads as dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in each s. And a longer passage in this slab-serif should move steadily beneath Redux's wide-spaced, softly contrasted heading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Its strongest tie to Redux is how both open their curves generously, so the wide, geometric heading and the dignified serif body meet halfway.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo reads big and open. Its tall lowercase and wide mouths should carry a longer passage easily, while Redux's wide spacing and mild thin strokes sit above it.
